name: Trap the Ghost
source:
Acryl is an adventurer and a thief. As a result of his solo adventures, his body has become transparent and unable to come into contact with anything; he was cursed to become a ghost. To make the curse stop, he needs to find a magic circle in a dungeon within three days. His anxiety strengthens the bond between him and his new companions. What's going to happen after the curse is broken...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.digiket.com/work/show/_data/ID=ITM0042987]DiGiket[/url]]
translation:
亚克莉尔是一名冒险家和小偷。由于独自冒险的结果，他的身体变得透明，无法接触到任何东西；他被诅咒变成了鬼。为了解除诅咒，他需要三天之内在地牢中找到魔法阵。他的焦虑加强了他和新同伴之间的联系。解除诅咒后会发生什么……？

[译自[url=https://www.digiket.com/work/show/_data/ID=ITM0042987]DiGiket[/url]]
